         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5042">smon 'jug seMs bskyed kyi rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la bstod pa</rs> 'di | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6312">lung rigs 'dzin pa se ston</rs> gyis bskul ba'i don du || <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4066">chos smra ba'i btsun pa thogs med</rs> kyis <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5692">chos rdzong</rs> du <lb n="15a2"/> bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5043">'jam dbyangs dkar po</rs>'o || shub+haM ||</seg></TEI>
